snp2.12:10.3: Kāmakāro: “wish-granter”. Ordinary people have no spell or magic gem to grant them what they want.
snp2.12:10.4: Saṅkheyyakāro: “comprehensibility-granter”. Saṅkheyya is “calculable, comprehensible”, not “after comprehension”. The Buddha has a gift for explaining things in a way that makes them comprehensible.
snp2.12:12.2: Text reads anomavīra (“unrivalled hero”), but read jānamanomavīriya (“one of unrivaled energy”) per Thag 21.1:65.2. The phrase parallels anomapañña (“one of unrivaled wisdom”) and thus is likely to refer to a mental quality.
